findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - Neon reports a tool title, requests permission using its call ID, and ends without a review.
Done when: An Antigravity review whose tool call is refused either returns Neon's written review or stops with a message that names the refused step, never "empty output".
The [ACP permission-request example](https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/v1/tool-calls) includes only `toolCallId`. Although the preceding `tool_call` can supply a title that Forge stores at src/forge/antigravity.py:429, this handler does not look it up, so the refusal says "unknown tool". The same finding remains when Neon returns parseable but incomplete JSON after a refusal: src/forge/antigravity.py:253 accepts an object with `findings`, but Autoreview rejects a missing `review_completion` at tests/fixtures/autoreview-ce14dcca/scripts/autoreview:7472 without naming the refused step. The existing test at tests/test_antigravity_review.py:233 already exercises that incomplete-report shape.

why: Neon's review ends with "review engine returned empty output" because a refused tool call cancels the turn, and the empty answer is accepted as a completed review, so close stops after two tries.
